acceptance.behavior: Successful credentials route through canonical profile authority and invalid credentials remain on /login.
The responsive login form exposes labeled email and password controls, recovery navigation, busy state, and an announced error.
The acceptance journey verifies the Supabase Auth user and reload-persistent authenticated session.
Profile onboarding state and normalized role select the canonical post-login destination.
The browser journey emits the required PBOS exact-revision acceptance manifest after successful execution.
One Playwright spec covers invalid credentials, successful login, durable reload, desktop, mobile, accessibility, security, and artifact creation.
The login status is announced and the browser journey rejects serious or critical axe violations.
Credential failures use a non-enumerating message and profile-load failure signs out the newly established session.
